text.content:
Roll on this table (or reuse an entry) whenever a random encounter check triggers on this floor:

  • A patrol or wandering hazard tied to the floor's threat passes through this area on a rotation; a failed Perception check meets it head-on. (near Chamber, Room 5)
  • This room refills with a new threat if left and returned to later, on the same table used for the floor's other random encounters. (near Corridor Junction, Room 12)
  • Roll a random encounter check when the party lingers here more than a few minutes - something has noticed them. (near Chamber, Room 10)
